blocks.text: WASHINGTON, United States — A Republican lawmaker moved Monday to impeach US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over the war in Iran, setting up a potentially explosive vote in Congress days after President Donald Trump’s party suffered a crushing midterm defeat. Kentucky Rep. Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment accusing Hegseth of illegally waging war without congressional authorization and abusing his powers as Pentagon chief. The Republican-controlled House could vote as early as Wednesday, with some lawmakers from Trump’s party signaling they might join Democrats in supporting the charges.
